nom: florence by mills Clean Magic Face Wash

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the cleanser is gentle, leaves skin neither oily nor stripped, and rinses off clean.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe sensitive skin and report no irritation or burning, with one noting the ingredient list is helpful for checking fragrance content.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports it cleaned well, while another (skin type unspecified) reports the product left her feeling a bit oily after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions wanting an anti-aging version, implying interest from mature-skin users, but no direct mature-skin outcome is described.

concerns.aging: Two identical reviews mention wanting to also get an 'aging' item from the brand, but neither reports any anti-aging effect from this cleanser itself.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say the wash left skin hydrated, soft or smooth and did not dry out or tighten the skin; one reviewer, however, felt it left her skin feeling dirty rather than hydrated after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says the product calms her skin and another that it never irritated her, but this is not framed around redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no burning, stinging, or reaction, suggesting the formula is generally non-irritating.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts, disappearing pimples, or reduced acne with regular use; one preteen's occasional spots reportedly were not irritated by it.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report the cleanser helped clear acne or pimples over time; one reviewer pairs it with a separate acne cleanser for best results, and one reviewer specifies she does not have acne-prone skin so cannot speak to that effect.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the wash leaves skin oily afterward and warns those with oily-skin concerns; another with combination skin says it left her not oily and not stripped.

extraits.texte: Though the reviews were spectacular, I find this cleanser to be everything except a cleanser. No suds whatsoever and it left my skin feeling dirty after use. Also as a makeup remover, it was a 0/10 for me. I don't understand the rave unless I was using it wrong, but I followed the directions blindly and was left so disappointed.

I love this cleanser. I don't wear makeup, so I can't speak to that, but it is so gentle on my combination skin. I'm not oily after I use it and not stripped either. It's great. It is a creamy but light consistency. It doesn't really suds up much, but it rinses off clean and leaves my skin feeling super fresh. It has a very light scent, and all the fragrant ingredients are listed if you have sensitive skin.

Ahhh I love it -it smells so good -it works so well, it made my skin feel so smooth. My skin is so sensitive, I can't use any skincare without getting a reaction but this doesn't give me a reaction💜💜.
It smells amazing but it leaves my skin a bit oily. If you don't have to much problems with oily skin i recommend this product!

extraits.titre: one of the best flo products!
extraits.texte: i use this every morning and night! it got rid of most of my acne so fast!! doesn't dry out the skin at all! i love to follow it up with the up in the clouds moisturizer!!
Preteen daughter has a few spots sometimes so she has started with skin care. This cleanser doesn't irritate or dry out her skin.

This face wash is super soothing, and I can't express my love for it more. It clears away my acne and I'm pairing it with the Cerave Foaming Facial Cleanser for best results. I love adding more Florence products to my skin routine!! THANK YOU MILLS!!!!!!!
